repos_data.description: Command-line YAML, XML, TOML processor - jq wrapper for YAML/XML/TOML documents
JSON library to expose simple handlers that lets you easily read and write json from various sources.

repo_meta_data.description: CLI tool and python library that converts the output of popular command-line tools, file-types, and common strings to JSON, YAML, or Dictionaries. This allows piping of output to tools like jq and simplifying automation scripts.
